title: BEEP! Korean Corpus of Online News Comments for Toxic Speech Detection
benchmark_measurement: Detection of social bias and hate speech based on various attributes, including religious affiliation.
findings: The models tested performed poorly on detecting biases in the 'others' category, which includes religious bias, as compared to the more prevalent gender bias in the dataset.
